attribution: Both defects were present on main before this PR.

findings.issue: All-unique compact relative layout frees full_to_unique before a fallible lookup; errdefer frees it again when lookup fails.
findings.before: Allocation-failure enumeration with a seven-token compact layout aborts with double free of a104-byte mapping.
findings.fix: Retain mapping ownership through the last fallible lookup, then free it before the successful return.

findings.issue: forwardFromHiddenRange leaks its current hidden tensor when later work fails.
findings.before: Native300-token one-layer allocation-failure enumeration reports MemoryLeakDetected at failure index4/105;5104 bytes remain allocated.
findings.fix: An errdefer follows the current hidden tensor across layer replacement until its successful explicit free.

performance_scope: These cleanup changes have not undergone a new optimized HTTP run. Earlier source-pinned capacity and timing evidence is retained; overall performance qualification remains partial.

coverage: Every allocation-failure point through duplicate and all-unique relative layouts.
Every allocation-failure point through partial encoder replay and a complete native encoder layer.
